task: Add --kube-api-qps/--kube-api-burst flags (defaults 50/100) applied to rest.Config, optional Helm chart values, docs, and burst diagnosis logging to eliminate client-go default 5 QPS / 10 burst rate-limiting during PV bursts.

events.summary: Add --kube-api-qps (default 50) and --kube-api-burst (default 100) flags to cmd/nfs-quota-agent wired to rest.Config, optional chart values kubeAPI.qps / kubeAPI.burst, docs in README and README-ko, shell completions, and diagnosis parsing for effective startup client limits. Not touched: quota logic, argv construction, /etc/projects, RBAC verbs, or filesystem backends.

Air-Gap E2E Stage D2 on the PR #242 run applied 100 PVs created at once at 2.56 (xfs), 2.55 (ext4) and 2.55 (btrfs) applies per second, mean gap 0.386-0.388 s, about 39 s total on each filesystem; cmd/nfs-quota-agent/main.go set no QPS so client-go used 5 QPS / burst 10, and each new PV costs 2 synchronous API calls (GET and UPDATE on annotations).

Flags --kube-api-qps (default 50) and --kube-api-burst (default 100) added with validation in cmd/nfs-quota-agent/kube_api.go and applied to rest.Config in main.go; optional chart values kubeAPI.qps and kubeAPI.burst added in daemonset.yaml and values.yaml; README/README-ko documented; completions updated; burst_diagnosis.py updated to collect effective startup limits from full logs.

Local regression verification passed: gofmt clean, go vet ./..., go test ./cmd/... ./internal/agent/... (ok cmd/nfs-quota-agent 0.670s, ok internal/agent 7.920s), helm lint (1 chart linted, 0 failed), and python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/e2e (Ran 16 tests, OK). The before/after effect on a real filesystem is pending the PR's Air-Gap E2E run and the QPS cause is strongly indicated but only proven if that run speeds up.
